text: PE incidence is about 12% in the Wells unlikely band and about 37% in the likely band.
About 95% of patients with acute aortic dissection score intermediate or high on ADD-RS.
Meta-analysis: ADD-RS of 1 or more is about 94% sensitive alone and close to 100% with D-dimer; the best threshold depends on setting.
ESC 2024 recommends a multiparametric diagnostic algorithm using ADD-RS (class I, level B).
Cochrane review: at 43% prevalence, a positive CT means about a 92% chance of appendicitis and a negative CT about 4%.
In one prospective comparison, CT found an alternative diagnosis in about a third of patients.
For causes other than stones, noncontrast CT and ultrasound had similar accuracy (CT sensitivity 74%).
